# Digital Petroleum — PumpSaathi (Complete Petrol Pump Management OS & Forecourt ERP)
> Website: https://www.digitalpetroleum.shop/
> Station App Entry: https://www.digitalpetroleum.shop/app.html
> Founder & Lead Architect: Neeraj Dev (Almora, Uttarakhand, India)
> Official Contact: digitalpetroleumhq@gmail.com

## Architecture Split (Clean Web Showcase + Native Android TWA App)
- `/index.html`: Official Digital Petroleum brand showcase, App Store download hub (Direct Signed APK, Indus Appstore, Amazon Appstore, Samsung Galaxy Store), transparent legal agreement summary, and complete static AI-readable system documentation.
- `/app.html`: Main Multi-Role PWA & Android TWA Station Operations Shell (Owner, Manager, Salesman, Viewer).
- `/owner.html` & `/owner_portal.js`: Executive God-Mode Owner Control Dashboard.
- `/party.html` & `/party_portal.js`: Customer-facing 6-digit PIN portal for live ledger statements, vehicle tracking, and UPI payments.

## Core Engineering Engines for Code Verification
- `/calc.js`: Core Mathematical Accounting Engine — computes nozzle sales (`p1-p4`, `d1-d4`), meter rollover detection, testing stock deductions, SBI/PNB Bank-as-Party auto-sync, cash closing (`kul - paytm - swipe - udhar - kharcha - bankOut`), and dip-chart stock reconciliation.
- `/app_day.js`: Daily Hisab & Chaining Engine — enforces day-to-day continuity (`openCash = prev.close`, `openStock = prev.actStock`, `opening = prev.closing`), auto-draft recovery, and Owner-only lock/unlock workflow.
- `/app_ledger.js`: Party & Bank Ledger Engine — includes Global Chain Recalculator (`recalculateAllDaysChain`) ensuring 100% mathematical parity between daily cash registers and party balances.
- `/rules.js`: Runtime Firestore Write-Interceptor & Security Rulebook (`R1` to `R11`) — blocks unverified ledger entries, enforces rate/opening locks, generates unique `PAY-` IDs, and prevents tampering on locked days.
- `/density.js` & `/tanker_report.js` & `/dip_chart.js`: ASTM 53B 15°C Standard Density & Thermal Volume Correction (VCF) engine to detect tanker transit shortages and adulteration.
- `/cibil.js`: Proprietary 300–900 Fleet & B2B Party CIBIL Credit Scoring & Wasooli Recovery Ladder.
- `/multi_pump.js` & `/pump_create.js` & `/pump_login.js`: Multi-Tenant SaaS Engine supporting BPCL, IOCL, HPCL, and custom stations with isolated collections and dynamic branding.
- `/upi_hisab.js`: Dynamic UPI Intent QR & payment reconciliation module with Customer Kundali CRM.
- `/assistant.js` & `/assistant_brain.js`: Offline-capable Hinglish/Hindi Cognitive Voice & Natural Language Operations Assistant.
- `/interactive_demo_blueprint.js` & `/demo_3m.js`: Interactive Feature & Core Logic Map + 3-Month full-station simulation engine.
